title: E-Bikes. Arson. Illegal Homes. Why Deadly N.Y.C. Fires Are on the Rise.
summary: Fatalities have nearly doubled this year. While a series of factors has driven the increase, the deadliest blazes have occurred in homes built more than 100 years ago.
